text:
Anya: Midday pulse — quick snapshot from my side. Canary is green but slow tails on one model; 3 cherrypicks queued (PRs 8421, 8423, 8430). Blocker: migration lock on user_profiles.db that's stalling cutover.
Raj: Which migration is holding it? I can try to force unlock if needed.
Anya: It's the add-index-2026 migration from PR 8418. DBs show a long-running vacuum job, probably from a backfill.
Mike: On it — pausing my CR for a sec, will check DB locks and the vacuum job. @Lina fyi since this touches read replicas.
Jen: FYI one of the cherrypicks (8430) has flaky integration tests on staging — failing on the job that seeds test vectors. I kicked a rerun.
Lina: If you need a temp rollback plan: we can pin traffic to the previous model variant and force the canary to 0.5 for 15m. Not ideal but keeps latency in SLO.
Anya: Good call. Plan B if we can't clear the migration: pin to v1.9 and hold train for 30m.
DeployBot: Canary rollout status: release-canary -> 45% traffic, all probes passing, avg p99 latency 210ms :white_check_mark:.
Mike: DB locks look like a single session holding an exclusive on the migration table. I dumped the session:
```
SELECT pid, usename, query_start, state, query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query LIKE '%add-index-2026%';
```
I can terminate it in 5 if we want to proceed.
Raj: Terminate + monitor results. If anything weird, abort and revert.
Anya: Go ahead Mike, terminate and post results. I'll coordinate with QA on the cherrypicks that depend on the migration.
Mike: Terminated session pid 54213. Lock released. Migration progress resumed, currently at 60%.
Jen: Tests are rerunning for 8430 — started a fresh staging run.
Lina: Confirming we bumped canary back to 70% for safety. Watching metrics.
Sean: ETA on clear-to-cut? If migration finishes in 10–15 we can aim for a 45m cut window.
Anya: If migration hits 100% in <=15, we do the cut. Otherwise we hold and escalate to infra.
Mike: Migration finished at 1758007400, no errors. All clear from DB side.
DeployBot: Deployment event: cut started at 1758007600, rolling to 3 AZs.
Jen: Staging tests for 8430 passed — marking as QA-ok.
Raj: I'll pick up the final canary watch and look for error spikes.
Anya: Final checklist: confirm PRs merged (8421,8423,8430) — Jen please confirm 8430 merged?
Jen: 8430 merged at 1758007685, builds green.
Anya: Great. Rolling forward then. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
Lina: I'll leave an alert window open for 1h post-cut. Ping me if anything: :eyes:
Sean: Posting a quick note to release board with the final status and PR refs.
Anya: Closing the midday pulse — will post a post-cut summary in ~45m.
